phases.notes: Phase 1 completed in 1 attempt. KEY IMPLEMENTATION NOTES: (1) Dispatcher.DispatchOptions/DispatchHandlers live in the Dispatcher namespace (undici-types dispatcher.d.ts `declare namespace Dispatcher`), NOT as top-level exports — used `Dispatcher.DispatchOptions` type aliases. (2) WrappingDispatcher cannot `implements Dispatcher` because EventEmitter's listeners() return type (Function[]) is broader than Dispatcher's narrowed overload — used structural typing with `as unknown as UndiciDispatcher` cast at the installUndiciDispatcher boundary (justified: undici's runtime only uses dispatch() and connect/disconnect emit events, both present and correctly typed). (3) Pre-existing deriveUrl bug surfaced by the undici-patch path: when BOTH view.hostname and hostHeader were set, hostHeader was preferred in the conditional but view.hostname (hostname-only) won in the hostWithPort computation, dropping the port. Fix: prefer hostHeader over view.hostname in hostWithPort. The change preserves all existing test assertions (interceptor.test.ts line 410's `http://127.0.0.1:${port}/v1/chat/completions` still passes because http.ClientRequest's req.hostname is undefined so the change is a no-op there). (4) Phase 1 wired the dual-patch correctly but did NOT solve two Phase-2 concerns: (a) global fetch passes options.body as an AsyncGenerator (typeof 'object', toString '[object AsyncGenerator]'), not string/Buffer/Uint8Array — Phase 2's test must drain it for model extraction; (b) captureCallerTrace() runs inside dispatch() and picks up undici internals, producing 'unknown' — Phase 2 may need a different trace strategy. Both recorded as discoveries. (5) `dependencies` block remains {} (zero-hard-deps invariant preserved). (6) NO new exported symbol in src/index.ts (unchanged). (7) Two discoverie entries appended to docs/roadmaps/llm-http-proxy/discoveries.md for Phase 2.

phases.notes: Phase 2 completed in 1 attempt with 1 PhaseAmendment (budget: 2 per phase, 3 per horizon — 2/2 phase, 1/3 horizon remain). KEY IMPLEMENTATION NOTES: (1) The phase-1 deferred choice `undici-fetch-body-is-async-generator` resolved into a TEE — undici wraps fetch's body in an AsyncIterable, and a naive drain (consuming the iterator independently) would trip UND_ERR_REQ_CONTENT_LENGTH_MISMATCH because undici's writer also consumes it. The fix: a single shared buffer filled by an upstream drainer; undici's writer pulls from a re-yielding iterator (`options.body = { [Symbol.asyncIterator]() { ... } }`) that walks the buffer; our capture branch waits for `upstreamDone` and pushes the full buffer to `state.requestBodyChunks`. Verified by manual probe — without the tee, `fetch(url, {body: '{"hello":"world"}'})` exits with `UND_ERR_REQ_CONTENT_LENGTH_MISMATCH`; with the tee, content-length integrity holds AND model extraction sees the body. (2) Jest 29.7.0 + Node 22.14.0 has a documented fetch-bridging gap: `globalThis.fetch` uses Node's bootstrap lazy-loader to spawn Node's BUNDLED undici instance (not the user-installed `require('undici')`). Direct probe: `globalThis.fetch === undici.fetch` is false; `setGlobalDispatcher` on user undici does NOT affect globalThis.fetch (wrapper-call count: 0); but DOES affect `ud.fetch(...)` (wrapper-call count: 1). Under plain Node 22.14 (no Jest), both paths route through the same wrapper (probe verified). The test calls `ud.fetch(...)` so the dual-patch proof surface is consistent under Jest — and matches the horizon-8 SDK-test pattern (Vercel AI SDK providers accept an explicit `fetch:` option). (3) The undici presence gate uses the same opt-in pattern as horizon-7's API-key-gated suites: a module-top `try { undici = require('undici'); } catch { undici = undefined; }` followed by `if (undiciInstalled && undici !== undefined) describe('...', () => globalFetchSuite(undici)) else describe.skip('...', globalFetchSuitePlaceholder)`. The placeholder test asserts `expect(undiciInstalled).toBe(false)` so the skip path is observably exercised (not a silent no-op). (4) The --no-save install of undici for PRESENT-state verification (`npm i -D undici@^6.21.1 --no-save`) followed by `rm -rf node_modules/undici` reverted cleanly: `git diff packages/llm-http-proxy/package.json` after revert shows only the Phase-0 peer-dep entry (the only Phase-2 ledger-row diff is the new test file + the source-file modification, both expected from the PhaseAmendment). (5) The `src/types-undici.d.ts` shim (added in Phase 0) keeps typecheck green in both states. (6) Both before-install and after-install dispatches under Jest verify the wrapper IS set: `before install: Agent`, `after install: WrappingDispatcher` — confirming the gate, the kDispatcherWrapper idempotency guard, and the installUndiciDispatcher branch all fire. (7) NO new exported symbol in src/index.ts (unchanged); `dependencies` block remains `{}` (zero-hard-deps invariant preserved); src/index.ts unchanged.
